intro.text: A dangerous vine on Patji that hangs in the treetops like a net, ready to drop on anything that disturbs it.

description.text: Disturbed, the net drops onto its prey and fastens itself with stinging barbs, then takes a few hours to draw back up.
Its distinctive curl lets trappers recognize it and keep away.

items.text: Dusk once set off a cutaway vine deliberately and hid his canoe in the undergrowth beside its tree, since other trappers avoid such vines.
After the First Company settled and tamed Patji, it cut down most of the vines and salted their roots so they could not grow back.
